2.17.2.title: Editing an invoice keeps its job costing
items: Saving an invoice from the edit screen no longer strips each line's job and cost code, so its revenue stays on the job-cost reports
An edited invoice posts the way a new one does: foreign-currency invoices at their exchange rate, and a changed invoice date moves its ledger entry
An invoice's total cannot be edited below what has already been paid, and paid / partly paid follows the payments

2.17.1.title: OpenAI works again
items: AI analysis with OpenAI: the current models, including the default gpt-5.4-mini, refused the request; they are sent the settings they accept
Reasoning models get room to think before answering, and a reply cut off at the limit now says so instead of reporting an unexpected response

2.17.0.title: Your ledger, in a spreadsheet
items: Trial Balance and General Ledger save as a spreadsheet (CSV) and a printable PDF; Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet gain the spreadsheet
The General Ledger shows each account's balance brought forward, a running balance, the source of every line and a period total that ties to the Trial Balance
Bank feeds: a SimpleFIN setup token from any SimpleFIN provider connects, not only bridge.simplefin.org

2.16.3.title: The Docker image starts again
items: Server / Docker installs: a freshly built image failed to start after a database library update; the library is pinned to the tested version
Desktop apps are unchanged from 2.16.2

2.16.2.title: Tax-exempt customers, wider amounts, and two forms put right
items: Estimates: the line-item cells follow their headings again (quantity sat under Cost code); picking an item fills its cost
Job Cost Entry: the dialog opens as wide as your window and the cost lines scroll instead of being cut off
A customer marked non-taxable is no longer charged sales tax on invoices, estimates or sales receipts made in the app
Money columns hold amounts up to 9,999,999,999,999.99, for currencies with large everyday amounts

2.16.1.title: Wave's full export imports its journals
items: Migrating from Wave: the full "Get all transactions" export now imports its journals — its debit and credit columns were not recognised, so the dry run passed and nothing was imported
For every migration source, a ledger whose amounts all read zero is refused by the dry run, with the file's own header row in the message
A second click on Import no longer posts the same journals again: what an earlier import already brought in is skipped, and the dry run says how many

2.16.0.title: The year at a glance
items: Two new overview cards under Customize: P&L year to date with cumulative net by month, and a Balance Sheet trend over the last twelve month-ends
The trend balances at every point and its latest point equals the Balance Sheet report; a nonprofit sees Activities and Statement of Financial Position
The chart of accounts import dialog offers a CSV template with the columns and example rows

2.15.0.title: Your chart, from your file
items: Chart of Accounts → Import… reads a CSV in the export's columns, any spreadsheet with Number / Name / Type, or hledger's account list
A dry run first: every row's fate with a reason, nothing written until you say so
Accounts you already have take the file's names; the control accounts the software posts to are renamed, never duplicated
Replace the seeded chart: unused accounts the file does not name are deactivated, control accounts and history stay

2.14.0.title: In and out of a company, and the terms once
items: Opening the app lands in your last company, with the picker one click away on the sign-in screen
Sign out returns to the company picker — no more closing and reopening to switch companies; the Companies page has a Switch company button
On a multi-user install the sign-in screen lists the users, so you pick your name and type only your own password
The first launch shows the short terms once — free forever for what shipped, the forms are aids and filing is yours, no warranty — and the Windows installer shows the full license

2.13.1.title: The words the server sends
items: Connecting QuickBooks Online works again — the sign-in handoff from Intuit was being refused before it could finish (contributed by CimarronSiteServices)
For nonprofits: every message the server sends now uses your words — a missing pledge says Pledge, not Invoice

What you post is written in the document's own words — a pledge posts as Pledge #…, a program-fee invoice stays Invoice #…, and the ledger, the email and the printed document agree; existing entries keep the words they were posted with
Default email templates name the document through {{ doc_label }} — Invoice or Pledge to match what is attached

2.13.0.title: Bank of America, in a file the bank produced
items: Import Bank of America checking and savings detail CSV exports into the bank feed review queue — contributed by Lazyjimpressions, and verified against exports the bank actually produced
The bank-import dialog shows that it is reading your file, and will not start a second import if you click twice
A Windows machine without the WebView2 runtime is told what it can do, and offered the app in its web browser instead

2.12.1.title: See an email template before you save it
items: Preview an email template edit against a real invoice before saving it. Editing the invoice email used to mean saving over a working template and mailing a customer to find out what it looked like — contributed by mdornich
The message shown when the app refuses to open a company file older than itself now names a repair script that is actually there. It named a path that was not included in the installed app

2.12.0.title: Your chart, your templates, your clipboard
items: Security: an email template could be edited to read stored passwords and API keys — the SMTP password, payment-provider keys, accounting-integration tokens — and mail them out. The settings screen has always hidden these, and the template walked around it. Credentials are now removed before any template can see them. Reported privately

You can remove accounts you do not use. A new company arrives with 57 accounts and, until now, not one of them could be deleted or hidden — so anyone whose business does not look like ours was stuck with a chart they did not choose. Deactivate, Reactivate and Delete are on the Chart of Accounts page now, with a button to show the inactive ones
Fifteen accounts still cannot be removed, because the software finds them by number when it posts. You can rename them to whatever you call them

The email template you save is the email that gets sent. Editing it under Settings saved correctly and changed nothing at all — the invoice email was always built from a fixed layout. There is a preview in the Email Invoice dialog now, rendered by the same code that sends, so you can see what a customer will get before they get it
Emailing an invoice works again. The Send button failed on every install, because the dialog sent a Message field the server refused. The message you type appears at the top of the email

Copy buttons explain themselves when they cannot copy, and leave the text selected so one keystroke finishes the job. Copying silently did nothing for anyone opening SlowBooks from another machine on the network

The app refuses to start against a company file older than itself, instead of starting and quietly making it impossible to upgrade. A file that has already been damaged this way can be repaired with scripts/repair-schema.py, which will not touch a table with anything in it

2.11.1.title: Wave imports work, and you can copy an API token
items: Importing from Wave's Account Transactions report now works. It read every row as empty and then reported the books as balanced, because zero equals zero — so the import appeared to check out and brought nothing in. Found and fixed by rchanks against a real six-year Wave export

A file Wave names "Account Transactions" is now treated as the ledger it is, instead of being mistaken for your chart of accounts. Several other exports that contain both words were being misfiled the same way
A Copy button on a newly created API token. The token is shown once and had to be selected by hand, which went wrong often enough that one person recovered theirs from a screenshot

2.11.0.title: Record a credit from a supplier
items: Vendor Credits: when a supplier credits you for a return, a short shipment or an overcharge, record it as its own document. It reduces what you owe that vendor, and you choose which bill it settles — or leave it on their account for the next one
A/P and A/R aging now show credits you are holding. A credit you had not yet applied was invisible on both reports, so they read higher than the account they are supposed to agree with
Returning stock to a supplier takes it off the shelf and out of Inventory, instead of leaving an asset on the balance sheet for goods that are gone

2.10.3.title: Attachments follow a company file between computers
items: The update notice moved to the top of the sidebar, where you see it when the app opens — it used to sit at the bottom of the menu, below everything, so most people never found it. The version you are running is shown there too
Attachments open again. Clicking an attachment returned nothing at all, and a file added on Windows could not be found when the same company file was opened on a Mac or Linux
The search results panel closes when you click away, clear the box or change page — it used to stay on screen until you reloaded
The Quick Entry log is readable in dark theme; it was white text on a white block

2.10.2.title: You can edit your chart of accounts again
items: Every account has an Edit button. Before this, no account in a new company could be edited at all — including renaming, which 2.10.1 told you was allowed
Accounts the software posts to are marked CONTROL, and their edit form explains why the number and type are fixed while the name is yours to change
The test suite now runs on a machine without the PDF rendering libraries, so the Windows box can run it too

2.10.1.title: A document is never accepted without its journal entry
items: Renumbering an account the software posts to — Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable and thirteen others — is refused instead of quietly breaking new documents; renaming is still yours to do
A posting that cannot find the account it needs now stops and names it, rather than saving a document that never reached the ledger
Opening a company file says once if its chart of accounts is missing an account the books depend on

2.10.0.title: The bank register is the ledger
items: A register entry posts to the general ledger, and the register shows every posting on the account with a running balance
Bank and credit-card accounts are flagged on the chart; every paid-from and deposit-to picker lists exactly those
Statement lines from feeds and imports wait in To review: match them to what you entered, or add them with a category — nothing posts silently
Transfers between accounts (that is how a card gets paid); credit-card charges pick the card and can be voided
Reconciliation ticks ledger lines, starts from the prior statement, and locks what it closed
Upgrading: the old register balance is shown once — post it as an opening balance or dismiss it
PDF receipts scan on Windows and macOS with nothing to install; poppler-utils is only needed on Linux

2.9.4.title: Company logo on every document
items: The company logo prints on invoices, estimates, statements, letters, donor documents and reports, not only the analytics PDF
Import and export failures say that they failed and put the details in the server log instead of the response

2.9.3.title: SimpleFIN request pinned to the checked address
items: The bank-feed bridge request connects to the address the SSRF guard approved, closing a DNS-rebinding window; certificate checks stay on the hostname

2.9.2.title: Security: HR and payroll are admin-only; Server Edition policy, SimpleFIN on PostgreSQL, credit-card feeds
items: Server Edition: payroll, tax forms, benefits, employee bank accounts, documents and portal tokens are admin-only for every role below admin; batch and bill payments lock the invoice or bill row
Server Edition over the LAN gets the strict script policy again; only the desktop window's own loopback connection is relaxed
SimpleFIN settings save on PostgreSQL installs (the settings value column is now text)
A bank feed can target a liability account, so credit-card feeds land on the card

2.9.1.title: Post-release tidy
items: AI Insights: a stored provider key can be removed (Remove beside the saved mark; the API clears on an explicit empty string)
Windows releases ship SHA256SUMS.windows beside the installer and zip
Nonprofit mode: the Contributions by Donor card and the analytics aging header speak donor, not sales and customer
Migrations create every table on their own; the install guide's counts are current

2.9.0.title: Nonprofit mode
items: Company Type → Nonprofit: donors, pledges, donations, funds and grants on every screen; the data never changes name
Funds with donor restrictions, a Release from Restriction document, Statement of Activities and Statement of Financial Position, fund balances
Program / management / fundraising on every expense, allocation rules with Split and month-end runs, Statement of Functional Expenses (Form 990 Part IX)
Donation receipts and acknowledgment letters with the IRS language; in-kind gifts; year-end giving statements
Pledge report over recurring pledges; write-offs to Bad Debt Expense; credit memos can be voided
P&L by Class groups on the line's class; voids carry every dimension
Save PDF lands in Documents → SlowBooks Pro → Reports and says so; saved reports are a compact list; statements compare to the prior year
Agents: unknown request fields are rejected (422), tax_rate is documented as a fraction and bounded, DELETE on a posted document names the void route, PTO enums in the spec
Desktop: Save PDF explains a refused Documents folder and says where the file went; macOS app stapled before the DMG; a fresh company can run depreciation

macOS: Save PDF, print preview, Save backup and Show in folder work again (the desktop bridge was blocked by the app's security policy since 2.1.0); Save CSV lands next to Save PDF with a Show-in-folder notice
First-run setup on a file that already has books names the company and prefills it; the company name in Settings and the picker can no longer disagree
AI Insights: a Custom (OpenAI-compatible) provider for any endpoint you name; the self-hosted Cloudflare Worker gateway's replies come through again

2.8.0.title: Benefits, all-state payroll, and an overview you can arrange
items: Benefits engine: benefit codes with rules, effective-dated rates, employer matching, employee groups, per-code GL and remittance bills
State withholding for all 50 states + DC with verified 2026 figures; state W-4 fields on the employee
PTO banks carry dollars and post a liability; actual payroll burden can flow to jobs by hours
Company Snapshot: pick, hide and reorder the cards per user, with five new cards
Sales tax per line: untaxed labor and taxed parts on one invoice
IIF and CSV export now carry classes, jobs, bills, deposits and sales receipts (#70)
Accessibility pass: real dialogs, table headers, contrast, tagged PDFs
Employee portal link opens in the employee's browser with a full address

2.7.0.title: Jobs, job costing, and receipt intake
items: Jobs under customers with cost codes, budgets and a drill-down cost tree
Job Cost Entry, time-to-job labor at loaded rates, allocations
Receipt intake: scan a receipt into a bill or expense
